クラス TextListController

  • java.lang.Object
    • jp.kyasu.awt.text.TextController
      • jp.kyasu.awt.text.TextListController
  • すべての実装されたインタフェース:
    java.awt.datatransfer.ClipboardOwner, java.awt.event.ActionListener, java.awt.event.FocusListener, java.awt.event.KeyListener, java.awt.event.MouseListener, java.awt.event.MouseMotionListener, java.awt.ItemSelectable, java.io.Serializable, java.util.EventListener
    直系の既知のサブクラス:
    ChoiceListController

    public class TextListController
extends TextController
implements java.awt.event.ActionListener, java.awt.ItemSelectable
    The TextListController class implements a view of a MVC model for the text list. The model of the MVC model is a TextListModel object and the view of the MVC model is a TextListView object.
    関連項目:
    TextListModel, TextListView, 直列化された形式
